cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import http.server, json, os, sys, threading, time

class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(n)
        rec = json.loads(body)
        print("server got", self.path, rec, file=sys.stderr)
        self.send_response(201)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'{"ok": true}')
    def log_message(self, *a): pass

srv = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8765), H)
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
time.sleep(0.3)

env = dict(os.environ, INGEST_ENDPOINT="http://127.0.0.1:8765/ingest")
import subprocess
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "sync.py"], cwd="/work", env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
print("stdout:", r.stdout)
print("stderr:", r.stderr)
print("exit:", r.returncode)
srv.shutdown()
EOF
